fusions.name: Hoofbeat Wave
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone ahead that deals 14 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3.5 tiles. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Cavalry Charge
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 30 damage, ignoring armour, harder the further it travels, up to 2.5 times its damage at maximum range.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Pulse
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds, and you hop 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Open Road
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 16%.
